population_note: Same clean, frozen train-monitor/validation populations as N06/N08; bounded pilot, not full source training exposure.
reliability_protocol_note: Established 2mm convention plus same-nearest-GT and 0.5mm next-anchor margin; 1mm stricter count is an audit sensitivity, not validation-tuned.
benefit_gate: In BOTH seeds: S1-minus-S0 conditional AP and fixed-cutoff 2mm Edge F1 subject-CI lower bounds >0; TP and long-positive recall nondecreasing, FP nonincreasing, near-negative FPR decreases. S1 also beats original AP/F1 point estimates without TP/long-recall loss or FP increase, lowers near FPR, and cycle-count MAE does not increase versus either control. No automatic unfrozen/R08 launch even if passed.
audit_limitation: Only 18 reliable <5mm negatives per training seed; 7/6 are incorrect at cutoff 0.5. Narrow fixed-feature pilot, not a definitive test of general hard-negative training.
